error.unknown: An error occurred in this stage.

stageView.loadError: Could not load this stage's data.

baseStix.descricao: Pick the STIX package version. The base is downloaded from the official MITRE source when no on-disk copy exists; the bundle dashboard is then shown.
baseStix.pronto: Bundle on disk and dashboard shown — Stage 1 can be completed.
baseStix.aguardando: Select a base and view the dashboard to complete Stage 1.
baseStix.erro: The STIX base selection could not be completed.

entrada.naoEncontrada: Campaign not found in this STIX base.

processamento.description: Automated structural modeling of the STIX dataset.

saida.notRun: Modeling has not run yet. Click “Run modeling” to generate the output.
saida.empty: No structural elements were extracted for this case.

campanha.descricao: Select a campaign from the STIX bundle to extract its attributes (identity, aliases and techniques).
campanha.semCampanhas: No campaigns available in this bundle.
campanha.naoExtraido: Select a campaign to extract and show its attributes.
campanha.falha: Could not extract the attributes of the selected campaign.

entrada.noInput: Stage 1 produced no techniques; there is no Stage 2 input.

processamento.description: Translation of abstract behaviors into executable steps.

saida.suppressed: No Stage 1 input; Stage 2 output is suppressed.
saida.noAbilities: This case has no curated Abilities.
saida.noAdversary: There is no Adversary grouping of Abilities for this case.

entrada.noAdversary: This case has no Adversary to emulate.

processamento.noOperation: No Operation is running for this case.

ambiente.descricao: The emulation creates/uses this isolated environment in your Docker. Today the topology is provisioned by the lab's docker-compose.
ambiente.isolado: Isolated — the attack-plane networks are internal (no route to the host or the internet). The attack does not leave the controlled environment.

confirmation.title: Safety confirmation — real attack execution
confirmation.description: Review the concrete commands and target containers. Execution starts automatically in a moment; confirm to start now. No command is fired without the isolation gate approved.
confirmation.previewLoading: Loading the commands that will run…

blocked.body: Environment not ready: Stage 5 is not concluded. Redirecting to Stage 5…

execution.refused: Execution did not start: the isolation/containment gate was not satisfied or Caldera is unavailable.
execution.startError: Could not start the Stage 6 execution.

connection.lost: Connection lost — reconnecting to the execution channel. Updates resume automatically; no need to reload the page.

stage5.title: Environment (Stage 5)
stage5.readOnly: Read-only verdict produced in Stage 5. Stage 6 does not re-run any environment check.

topologia.descricao: Isolated lab provisioned in your Docker: internal hosts and networks the campaign is emulated against.

isolamento.isoladoDescricao: The attack-plane networks are internal (no route to the host or the internet). Stage 4 auto-completed and Campaign Execution is unlocked.
isolamento.indisponivelDescricao: Isolation could not be verified (Docker daemon unavailable). For safety (fail-closed), Stage 4 does not complete and Campaign Execution stays blocked. The topology is still shown.
isolamento.bloqueado: Stage 5 (Campaign Execution) stays blocked until isolation is confirmed.

falha.estagio6Bloqueado: Stage 6 (Campaign Execution) stays blocked until provisioning completes.

parametrosAmbiente.descricao: Artifact derived from the curated DAG nodes; defines the emulation environment for Stage 5.

hosts.vazio: No target host derived for this case.

relatorio.descricao: Consolidation of execution results, sufficiency measurement and Stage 6 verdict.
relatorio.notRun: Execution has not completed yet; the report will be available at the end of Stage 6.

metricas.nota: Initial measurement proposal, to be refined.

emulation.title: Confirm adversary emulation
emulation.description: Review the complete list of concrete commands and each one's target container before confirming. Nothing runs until you explicitly confirm.
emulation.previewLoading: Loading the commands that would run…
emulation.previewError: Could not load the command preview.
emulation.noCommands: There are no concrete commands to emulate for this case.
emulation.destinationExternal: External destination — the Operation will be refused
emulation.externalWarning: One or more commands target a destination outside the internal networks. Containment will refuse execution until they are fixed.

contencao.title: Containment not satisfied
contencao.body: A command targets a destination outside the internal networks; the Operation was refused.

isolamento.title: Isolation not satisfied
isolamento.body: A target container is not isolated; the Operation was aborted.

indisponivel.title: Docker environment unavailable
indisponivel.body: Caldera did not respond at the configured address within 10 seconds. No Operation was started.

wizard.blockedHint: Complete the previous stage to advance.
wizard.stage1ErrorHint: Modeling failed. Fix the issue to advance.
wizard.preConcluidoNota: This stage was already prepared by curation: the result existed before you acted.
